manifest.algorithm: Sort relative paths with JavaScript Array.sort() (all paths are ASCII). For each path in that order, append UTF-8 path bytes, one NUL byte (0x00), exact file bytes without normalization, and one NUL byte. Compute SHA-256 over the resulting concatenation. Individual file hashes use exact file bytes only.
manifest.pseudocode: const h=createHash("sha256"); for (const path of paths.sort()) { h.update(path+"\0"); h.update(readFileSync(path)); h.update("\0"); } h.digest("hex");

findingsFixed.problem: A newly confirmed lead on an old recovered conversation could remain outside the owner inbox LIMIT100 because sorting used only the old conversation timestamp.
findingsFixed.fix: Join only consented requests and sort/display the maximum of conversation ISO time and request epoch-millisecond time.
findingsFixed.validation: Regression creates 101 newer conversations: draft remains absent and confirmation resurfaces the old conversation first with the correct timestamp.

findingsFixed.problem: Cancellation after claim but before the first transport attempt changed SENDING/attempts=0 to UNKNOWN and permanently blocked a fresh preview despite zero sends.
findingsFixed.fix: Atomically mark never-attempted claimed work CANCELLED and clear its unused lease. Preserve UNKNOWN for attempted or explicitly uncertain work. The final pre-transport attempts increment remains fenced by state, lease and revocation.
findingsFixed.validation: Deterministic test pauses signing, cancels, confirms a replacement, then resumes the old signer. It sends nothing and cannot alter the replacement; only the replacement event is subsequently applied.

contractFollowupAddressed.details: Owner-only thread responses now project validated event ID, attempts, allowlisted error code and matching APPLIED/QUARANTINED receipt IDs. Guest responses omit diagnostics; arbitrary provider fields and credentials are suppressed. Owner UI is read-only.
